net_metering_survey.title: Net-metering: Energy Dashboard Model
net_metering_survey.description:
Under the net-metering system, solar energy surplus is stored in a virtual warehouse with a 20% or 30% operator discount (in-kind fee). The default Home Assistant Energy Dashboard treats all export and import as raw physical grid exchange, distorting self-consumption and financial balances.

Select your PV micro-installation capacity and desired presentation model:

ergo5_warning.title: A copy of the base ergo5 integration was detected
ergo5_warning.description:
A copy of the ergo5 integration (`ergo5/hass-energa-my-meter-api`) was found on this system:
{paths}

It uses the same domain `energa_mobile` as this integration. Keeping both copies can cause conflicts and duplicate entities/statistics. It is recommended to remove the ergo5 copy first; existing entities and long-term statistics are preserved.

Tick the box to continue anyway.

prices.title: Energy Prices
prices.description: Set full energy prices for cost calculation in Energy Panel. IMPORTANT: Enter total variable cost per 1 kWh gross (active energy + variable distribution + taxes/VAT), so Energy Panel accurately tracks invoice costs.

data.import_price: Total gross price per kWh (active energy + variable distribution + VAT) [PLN]
data.import_price_1: Total gross price per kWh Zone 1 (Peak / Day — active + distribution) [PLN]
data.import_price_2: Total gross price per kWh Zone 2 (Off-peak / Night — active + distribution) [PLN]
data.balance_baseline_import: Prosumer baseline meter import [kWh] (advanced, not needed when invoice date is set)
data.balance_baseline_export: Prosumer baseline meter export [kWh] (advanced, not needed when invoice date is set)
data.bank_initial_kwh: Bank balance from invoice [kWh] (optional, leave empty for auto FIFO from API)
data.bank_initial_kwh_l1: Bank balance Zone 1 / Peak from invoice [kWh] (optional)
data.bank_initial_kwh_l2: Bank balance Zone 2 / Off-peak from invoice [kWh] (optional)
data.bank_initial_pln: Bank initial PLN (new system, from invoice)
data.inverter_energy_entity: Inverter Energy Entity (PV Total/Daily kWh for Autoconsumption)
data.rce_auto_fetch: Auto-fetch RCEm from PSE API every 24h
data.use_rolling_365d: Old system: rolling 365-day FIFO bank from statistics (needs history)
data.tariff_energy_day: Tariff: sale energy day L1 [PLN/kWh] (from invoice!)
data.tariff_energy_night: Tariff: sale energy night L2 [PLN/kWh] (from invoice!)
data.tariff_trade_fee: Tariff: monthly trade fee [PLN] (from your invoice!)
data.tariff_capacity: Tariff: capacity fee [PLN/month] (empty = auto URE 2026 bracket)
data.tariff_product: Tariff: seller product (rate table) — empty = automatic

history.title: Download History
history.description:
**Contract Date:** {contract_date}

Select start date. Data download runs in background for all meters.

fetch_history.name: Fetch history
fetch_history.description: Fetches historical hourly data from the Energa API.

start_date.name: Start date
start_date.description: Date to start fetching from (format YYYY-MM-DD).

meter_id.name: Meter ID / Serial
meter_id.description: Optional serial or point ID to fetch only for a single meter.

generate_dashboard.name: Generate dashboard
generate_dashboard.description: Generates or refreshes a dedicated Lovelace dashboard for Energa meters.

url_path.name: URL Path
url_path.description: URL slug for the dashboard (e.g. energa-rachunek).

title.name: Title
title.description: Title of the dashboard in sidebar.

meter_id.name: Meter ID
meter_id.description: Optional meter serial/ID to generate only for a single meter.

reconcile_invoice.name: Reconcile invoice
reconcile_invoice.description: Performs per-line audit reconciliation comparing seller invoice against canonical calculation.

invoice_number.name: Invoice Number
invoice_number.description: Unique identifier of the seller invoice (e.g. FES/00017).

day_kwh.name: Day zone consumption (kWh)
day_kwh.description: Optional L1 (day) kWh for G12w. When omitted, consumption_kwh is split 50/50.

invoiced_gross.name: Invoiced gross (PLN)
invoiced_gross.description: Total gross amount printed on the invoice header.

invoiced_lines.name: Invoiced lines
invoiced_lines.description: Optional list of invoice line items to compare against the computed lines.

verify_period.name: Verify period
verify_period.description: Recomputes a full Energa invoice for an arbitrary [start, end] period and returns the breakdown as a service response.

start.name: Period start
start.description: First day of the period (YYYY-MM-DD or ISO datetime).

end.name: Period end
end.description: Last day of the period, inclusive (YYYY-MM-DD or ISO datetime).

entry_id.name: Config entry ID
entry_id.description: Optional config entry; defaults to the first Energa entry.

meter_id.name: Meter ID / Serial
meter_id.description: Optional meter serial or point id when the account has several.

rcem_pln.name: RCEm (PLN/kWh)
rcem_pln.description: Market price used to value export. Defaults to the coordinator cache, then Options, then the last-known value.

bank_open_1.name: Opening bank L1 (kWh)
bank_open_1.description: Optional manual opening balance of the net-metering warehouse for zone 1.

bank_open_2.name: Opening bank L2 (kWh)
bank_open_2.description: Optional manual opening balance of the net-metering warehouse for zone 2.

deposit_open_pln.name: Opening deposit (PLN)
deposit_open_pln.description: Optional manual opening balance of the prosumer deposit in PLN.

clear_period.name: Clear period
clear_period.description: Clears the saved verification period dates from the config entry options.

entry_id.name: Config entry ID
entry_id.description: Optional config entry; defaults to the first Energa entry.
